from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Fill Deep Well Plate with LB and Inoculate with Glycerol Stock",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define liquids
    lb = protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    glycerol_stock = protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#FF0000")
    
    # Load labware
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", "1")
    deep_well_plate = protocol.load_labware("usascientific_96_wellplate_2.4ml_deep", "2")
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", "3")
    
    # Load tip racks
    tip_rack_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", "4")
    tip_rack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", "5")
    
    # Load instruments
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_rack_20])
    
    # Load LB into reservoir
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=50000)
    
    # Load glycerol stock into each well of glycerol plate
    for well in glycerol_plate.wells():
        well.load_liquid(liquid=glycerol_stock, volume=50)
    
    # Fill deep well plate with 500 ul LB per well
    for well in deep_well_plate.wells():
        p1000.pick_up_tip()
        p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(500, well)
        p1000.drop_tip()
    
    # Inoculate each well with 5 ul glycerol stock
    for well in deep_well_plate.wells():
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_plate[well.name])
        p20.dispense(5, well)
        p20.drop_tip()

protocol.py: 1 biology problem (1 note).

1. NOTE UNMIXED-AT-END: 96 wells never mixed after glycerol_stock went in (1% of the well)
   line 45:  p20.dispense(5, deep_well)
   At line 45 the robot added glycerol_stock to wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88
   more in slot 2, which already held lb (this line did it 96 times). The addition was 1% of
   the well, nothing mixed the well afterwards, and the run ended with them that way. Two
   liquids layered in a small well do not mix on their own, so what the well holds is not at
   the concentration you calculated. If the plate is vortexed and spun down before it is
   used, nothing is wrong; if it goes straight to the instrument, the wells are not what the
   protocol says they are.
   Affected: wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 2.
   Fix: Mix wells A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8 and 88 more in slot 2 after line 45:
   `mix_after=(5, 404)` on the transfer, or `pipette.mix(5, 404, well)`, with the volume
   about 80% of what the well holds.
   Source: Artel: automated liquid handlers as sources of error
           https://www.bioprocessintl.com/assays/automated-liquid-handlers-as-sources-of-error
   Source: Illumina: normalising library concentrations (pipette up and down 10 times to
   mix)
           https://support.illumina.com/ko-kr/bulletins/2017/03/best-practices-for-manually-normalizing-library-concentrations.html
   Source: Thermo PowerTrack user guide (a reaction plate not mixed well gives variable
   replicates)

tool_calls.arguments:
{"text": "from opentrons import protocol_api

metadata = {
    "protocolName": "Fill Deep Well Plate with LB and Inoculate with Glycerol Stock",
    "apiLevel": "2.19"
}

def run(protocol: protocol_api.ProtocolContext):
    # Define liquids
    lb = protocol.define_liquid(name="lb", description="LB medium", display_color="#0000FF")
    glycerol_stock = protocol.define_liquid(name="glycerol_stock", description="Glycerol stock", display_color="#FF0000")
    
    # Load labware
    reservoir = protocol.load_labware("nest_1_reservoir_195ml", "1")
    deep_well_plate = protocol.load_labware("usascientific_96_wellplate_2.4ml_deep", "2")
    glycerol_plate = protocol.load_labware("nest_96_wellplate_100ul_pcr_full_skirt", "3")
    
    # Load tip racks
    tip_rack_1000 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_1000ul", "4")
    tip_rack_20 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_20ul", "5")
    tip_rack_300 = protocol.load_labware("opentrons_96_tiprack_300ul", "6")
    
    # Load instruments
    p1000 = protocol.load_instrument("p1000_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_rack_1000])
    p20 = protocol.load_instrument("p20_single_gen2", "right", tip_racks=[tip_rack_20])
    
    # Load LB into reservoir
    reservoir["A1"].load_liquid(liquid=lb, volume=50000)
    
    # Load glycerol stock into each well of glycerol plate
    for well in glycerol_plate.wells():
        well.load_liquid(liquid=glycerol_stock, volume=50)
    
    # Fill deep well plate with 500 ul LB per well
    for well in deep_well_plate.wells():
        p1000.pick_up_tip()
        p1000.aspirate(500, reservoir["A1"])
        p1000.dispense(500, well)
        p1000.drop_tip()
    
    # Inoculate each well with 5 ul glycerol stock using p20
    for deep_well, glycerol_well in zip(deep_well_plate.wells(), glycerol_plate.wells()):
        p20.pick_up_tip()
        p20.aspirate(5, glycerol_well)
        p20.dispense(5, deep_well)
        p20.drop_tip()
        
        # Mix the well using p300 (now loaded on left, replacing p1000)
        p300 = protocol.load_instrument("p300_single_gen2", "left", tip_racks=[tip_rack_300])
        p300.pick_up_tip()
        p300.mix(300, 5, deep_well)
        p300.drop_tip()"}
